UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1989 
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome  
 
Product Name:Zokinvy  
Diagnosis 
Progeroid Laminopathies  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of processing deficient Progeroid laminopathy  
 
AND 
 
2 - Documentation of ONE of the following:  
• 
Heterozygous LMNA (gene) mutation with progerin-like protein accumulation  
• 
Homozygous or compound heterozygous ZMPSTE24 (gene) mutations
